name: How long does kitchen countertop installation take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen countertop installation take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard kitchen countertop installation usually takes four to eight hours for the physical install once the slabs are fabricated. However, the full timeline from initial laser templating to completion typically spans one to three weeks. After your base cabinets are fully secured, our team creates an exact digital template, cuts and polishes the stone off-site, and then arrives to set the slabs, join seams, cut sink holes, and secure everything in place.
acceptedAnswer.description: Physical countertop installation takes one day, usually 4 to 8 hours. The complete process, including templating and fabrication, typically takes 1 to 3 weeks.
